name: do-i-need-ai-for-this
description: Reviews an automation idea or implementation and puts model judgment inside the smallest safe, testable architecture.

interface.displayName: Do I Need AI for This?
interface.longDescription: Produce or audit a machine-checked architecture verdict that separates deterministic work, model judgment, and human authority; selects the smallest safe pattern; exposes evidence and assumptions; and prevents incomplete verifiers from authorizing consequential actions.
defaultPrompt: Find the smallest safe architecture for this automation.
Audit this agent for wasted model calls and missing human gates.
Show exactly what the verifier proves before this output can act.
